description: This file contains utility functions for formatting weather data such as temperature, wind speed, date/time, and weather conditions into display-friendly strings, as well as mapping weather condition objects to icon tokens. It is part of a frontend weather display application.

methods.name: formatTemp(value, units = 'metric', opts = {})
methods.description: Formats a temperature value with the appropriate unit symbol ('°C', '°F', or 'K') and rounds it to specified decimals.

methods.name: formatWind(speed, units = 'metric', opts = {})
methods.description: Formats wind speed with unit labels ('m/s' or 'mph') and rounds to specified decimals.

methods.name: formatTime(ts, locale = undefined, opts = {})
methods.description: Converts a timestamp (milliseconds) into a localized time string, formatted as HH:MM.

methods.name: formatDate(ts, locale = undefined, opts = {})
methods.description: Converts a timestamp (milliseconds) into a localized date string, showing short weekday, month, and day.

methods.name: mapConditionToIcon(weather = {})
methods.description: Maps a weather condition object to an internal icon token based on weather code or description, used for icon display.
